scope_guards: SPZ1, SPZ2 and SPZ3 represent different groundwater travel-time and catchment concepts.
Source Protection Zones are screening evidence and not measured contamination or drinking-water quality.
Groundwater Safeguard Zones can differ from SPZ boundaries and target specific deterioration risks.
A safeguard action plan is not proof that measures were completed or a site is compliant.
Merged public boundaries are not abstraction ownership, legal title or exact borehole geometry.
Groundwater position statements are policy evidence and not permit grants or planning decisions.
Zone absence is not proof of zero groundwater sensitivity or pollution risk.
No score or promotion is written without exact site, current zone, action plan, hydrogeology and permit evidence.
